title: Spotify expands AI remix and covers project with Merlin partnership
excerpt: Spotify says Merlin, which represents more than 30,000 independent labels and distributors, has joined Universal Music Group in backing its upcoming AI-powered remix and covers product. The paid tool will let fans create AI-generated covers and remixes of participating artists’ music while ensuring artists opt in, receive credit, and are compensated.
content_html:
During its second-quarter earnings call on Tuesday, Spotify again teased the upcoming release of a new product that will allow music fans to leverage AI to make covers and remixes of artists’ music, with the artists’ consent.

The company also announced that Merlin, a licensing partner for independent labels and distributors, has now joined Universal Music Group (UMG) on the new AI music effort. The deal brings more than 30,000 labels from Merlin’s network to the product, which will allow fan-made covers and remixes by artists who agree to participate.

Spotify has positioned its AI music product as being significantly different from the more controversial AI music startups that have been used to create fully artificial songs. Instead, Spotify co-CEO Gustav Söderström told investors on Tuesday’s call that the company’s AI music product will be about “real artists, not fake artists.”

“We want artists to be consenting [to add] their work into this catalog, so people can play around with covers and remixes based on their art,” added co-CEO Alex Norström. “We also obviously want to give them credit. And last but not least…we not only have the consent and give credit, but we also drive the compensation for this. So, really, we’re talking about the first legal way to partake in this AI tailwind that we see coming for interactive music,” he said.

AI music has flooded streaming services. Music streamer Deezer recently noted that more than 50% of daily track uploads were generated with AI, up from 10% in January 2025.

The company told investors that a research preview of the fan remix and covers product would initially be made available to a subset of users. Spotify also noted that it would not require a full music catalog to get started. The company did not say when the preview would arrive.

The new tool will launch as a paid add-on, creating an additional revenue stream for artists, Spotify previously said.

“Our remix and covers I think is an incredibly exciting product again because there is no one else that can really do this,” Söderström said. “Normal generative music will happen with or without us. This product will not happen without us, and it needs to exist so that existing artists can participate in this.”

content_html_zh:
在周二的第二季度财报电话会议上，Spotify 再次预告即将发布的新产品，该产品将允许乐迷在征得艺术家同意的情况下，利用人工智能对艺术家的音乐进行翻唱和混音。

该公司还宣布，独立唱片公司和发行商的授权合作伙伴 Merlin 现已加入环球音乐集团 (UMG)，共同开展新的人工智能音乐工作。 这笔交易将 Merlin 网络中的 30,000 多个唱片公司纳入该产品，这将允许同意参与的艺术家进行粉丝制作的翻唱和混音。

Spotify 将其人工智能音乐产品定位为与更具争议性的人工智能音乐初创公司截然不同，后者被用来创作完全人工的歌曲。 相反，Spotify 联合首席执行官 Gustav Söderström 在周二的电话会议上告诉投资者，该公司的人工智能音乐产品将是关于“真正的艺术家，而不是假艺术家”。

“我们希望艺术家同意将他们的作品添加到这个目录中，这样人们就可以根据他们的艺术作品进行翻唱和混音，”联合首席执行官 Alex Norström 补充道。 “我们显然也想给予他们信任。 最后但并非最不重要的一点是……我们不仅获得同意并给予认可，而且我们还为此提供补偿。 所以，实际上，我们正在谈论第一种参与人工智能顺风的合法方式，我们认为互动音乐即将到来，”他说。

人工智能音乐已经席卷流媒体服务。 音乐流媒体 Deezer 最近指出，超过 50% 的每日曲目上传是通过 AI 生成的，而 2025 年 1 月这一比例为 10%。

该公司告诉投资者，粉丝混音和翻唱产品的研究预览最初将提供给部分用户。 Spotify 还指出，它不需要完整的音乐目录即可开始。 该公司没有透露预览版何时发布。

Spotify 此前表示，这一新工具将作为付费插件推出，为艺术家创造额外的收入来源。

“我认为我们的混音和翻唱再次成为令人难以置信的令人兴奋的产品，因为没有其他人可以真正做到这一点，”Söderström 说。 “无论有没有我们，正常的生成音乐都会发生。 如果没有我们，这个产品就不会出现，它需要存在，以便现有的艺术家可以参与其中。”
